title: fix(app-shell): `INHERITED_TARGET` docblock quotes the read the resolver performs (objectui#10159)
body:
Fixes #10159
Clause-②: no

## What

One line, in the docblock above `INHERITED_TARGET` in the metadata-admin `ActionPreview`. It quoted the action-param resolver as reading `referenceTo: param.reference ?? field.reference_to`. The code reads `referenceTo: param.reference ?? field.reference`, in `resolveActionParam`, the per-param step `resolveActionParams` maps over. It has read that way since objectui#6837 narrowed it. `reference_to` is a field-definition key `@objectstack/spec` refuses by name (`unrecognized_keys`, suggesting the rename to `reference`). So the comment pointed an author at metadata the platform rejects. The quotation now matches the code. It was already cited by content (a symbol plus a quoted expression, no path and no line), and that shape is kept.

## Premise, re-derived on `origin/main` (`5ea623ea`) before editing

`git grep -n "param.reference ??" -- packages/app-shell` returned two rows: the resolver's code reading `field.reference`, and this docblock quoting `field.reference_to`. The spec refusal was read on objectstack `origin/main`: the conversions registry's "always REFUSED `reference_to` by name" paragraph, and the conversions test "the canonical field schema declares `reference` and rejects `reference_to` with the rename".

## The pin

`ActionPreview.inheritedTargetCitation-10159.test.ts` sits beside the existing `ActionPreview` tests and runs in the unit project. It follows the shape of the repo's docblock-truth pins (`referenceRailRoute-9816`, `rootLandingHasOneResolver-10042`):

- The quotation is re-derived from the docblock (the backtick span that starts `referenceTo:`). The test never transcribes it.
- The quotation must occur in the resolver's code, with comments masked by the shared `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs`, so prose about the read cannot satisfy it.
- The match is at a token boundary, not a substring match. A quotation of `field.reference` would therefore not pass against code that reads `field.reference_to`, the mirror image of this defect.
- CONTROL: the same reader, mask and boundary find every `referenceTo:` read the resolver has. DISCRIMINATOR: the boundary refuses a prefix of a longer identifier.
- No line numbers anywhere.

## Ablation (a one-time proof, run from the committed fix `9e8b6718`)

The mutation ran through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, inside a script with its own `trap` restore on EXIT, INT and TERM. It changed the anchor `` field.reference`). `` to `` field.reference_to`). ``. Anchor count went 1 to 0, replacement count 0 to 1, and the blob `ff67f1a4` became `447a4c85`.

- **While mutated:** `Tests  1 failed | 3 passed (4)`. The failing case was `that quotation occurs in the resolver's code, as whole tokens`, with the message "the docblock quotes `referenceTo: param.reference ?? field.reference_to`, which the resolver does not perform". The landing, CONTROL and DISCRIMINATOR cases stayed green. That is the predicted direction: red.
- **After restore:** the blob equals the HEAD blob `ff67f1a4`, `git diff HEAD` is empty, and the on-disk counts are back to 1 for the new quotation and 0 for the old one.

## Verification at HEAD `ee6d0ded` (the final commit)

- The pin plus both `ActionPreview` neighbours, repo-root form: `Test Files  3 passed (3)`, `Tests  14 passed (14)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exits 0. The test program includes the new pin (`--listFilesOnly`: 1 hit).
- `pnpm check:control-bytes` passes. `pnpm check:new-line-citations` reports 0 citations added, over 3 files compared, with its synthetic controls PASS. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` passes.
- These ran on content identical to HEAD, with the changeset on disk: `check-test-path-roots`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask` (no carrier outside DEBT), `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-claims` (report-only), `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `check-lint-coverage`, and the `markdown-test-inputs` and `unit-registry-absence-collision` script tests. All exit 0. The corpus sweep's single disagreement is the pre-existing `DocsIndex.tsx` residue held under objectui#7882.
- The whole `previews/__tests__/` directory ran at `9e8b6718`, before the changeset existed: 13 of 13 files, 135 tests passed.
- The dependency closure `@object-ui/app-shell^...` was built first (turbo, all cached), so type-check read current `dist` typings.

## Lint: narrowed, with the narrowing proven

- **Population, from ESLint's own config:** both touched source files are linted (2 JSON entries, no ignore notice). The changeset is outside the population: `File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied`.
- **Count, from `--format json`:** 2 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. This is the package's own form: `eslint` run in `packages/app-shell` with inline config honoured.
- **Invariance:** `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no `projectService`, no `parserOptions.project`), and no local rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem. So this diff cannot move a verdict on any untouched file.
- **Note:** under `--no-inline-config`, `ActionPreview.tsx` shows 2 `react-hooks/static-components` errors. They are the two lines that already carry `eslint-disable` on base, and this diff does not touch them.

## Changeset: empty frontmatter, measured

The presence gate requires a changeset, because published `src` changed. It is declared as releasing nothing, based on a measurement of the emit. After `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell build`:

- the emitted `ActionPreview.d.ts` contains neither `INHERITED_TARGET` nor the quotation (0 hits; control: the exported `ActionPreview`, 2 hits);
- the emitted `ActionPreview.js` carries the comment, and no runtime token moved;
- the pin is not emitted.

Precedent: objectui#6572 (a docblock on a non-exported member took an empty frontmatter) versus objectui#5213 (JSDoc on exported declarations reached the `.d.ts` and took `patch`).

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope and untouched, as the claim states. First, the second param-collection handler in `RecordDetailView`, which does not take the object-store union that objectui#10158 added. Carrier: whoever next edits either handler; the parity pin `RecordDetailView.paramRuntimeParity-6431` names both. Second, `RuntimeField.reference_to` in the resolver, a declaration that no read has consumed since objectui#6837. Carrier: none.
- The commits carry no attribution trailers, so they are model-free by omission. Attribution is this body and the session below.
